reason: In queue_consumer.py (patch lines 363-366), close() sets shutdown_event and joins commit_thread before calling queue_pool.shutdown(). That shutdown uses q.shutdown(immediate=False) and joins the workers, so queued items are still processed. The commit loop's last pass (patch lines 302-317) runs before that drain, and nothing calls get_committable_offsets or commit_function afterwards, so offsets finished during the drain are never committed.
